lines.2: 「Now, you are going to explain yourself.」
lines.6: 「I understand that you and Date have jobs. But why did you hide it from me?」
lines.7: 「Did you think I would object? School rules permit part-time work during long holidays. I would not have opposed it.」
lines.10: 「You refused to explain yourself, so I have spent the last two or three days feeling unsettled.」
lines.11: 「Mm... I'm sorry I worried you that much.」
lines.12: 「I guess keeping it secret and pulling everything off smoothly only works in manga and TV dramas.」
lines.20: 「Yeah. The ones you were looking at right after summer vacation began.」
lines.21: 「I secretly checked the shoes at home to get your size.」
lines.22: 「But it is not my birthday or anything.」
lines.23: 「It's to thank you for everything you do.」
lines.24: 「I considered a ring, actually. But that can wait until next time.」
lines.26: 「Then you should have told me sooner.」
lines.29: 「I think plenty of people try to surprise someone.」
lines.30: 「But working so hard to surprise me only to get caught makes you look rather foolish.」
lines.32: 「Hehe. Do not look so dejected. Rest assured, I am still thoroughly surprised.」
lines.33: 「I told you that I like people who give their all. The thought alone makes me happy.」
lines.34: 「I should give you something in return...」
lines.35: 「You don't need to. This is a token of my everyday gratitude.」
lines.37: Otome slipped her arms around my waist.
lines.38: Then she pulled me firmly toward her.
